newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SGB plays down G-Bank, BBL merger comment.
newsitem.headline: SGB plays down G-Bank, BBL merger comment.

text.p: Belgian holding company Ste Generale de Belgique (SGB) said on Monday there were no merger talks ongoing between its Generale Bank unit and Banque Bruxelles Lambert (BBL) and played down comments about this made by SGB chief executive officer Philippe Liotier.
"Mr. Liotier's comments in VFB's magazine contain no new information. There are no talks about a BBL-Generale Bank merger," an SGB spokeswoman told Reuters.
Flemish Investment Club VFB's magazine quoted Liotier as saying he was still interested in a Generale Bank-BBL merger.
